title: Activation through a provider and its binding in one account-store record
spec: AccountStore::activate_external(activation, issuer, subject, now) commits AccountOp::ActivatedExternal (tag 13: the Activated fields, then issuer and subject) as one record and applies both the activation and the binding. A first device makes a person with no password (ExternalPassword otherwise) bound to an identity no one holds (ExternalInUse otherwise); another device needs the person bound to exactly that identity (ExternalMismatch otherwise, also for a person bound to nothing). Empty identity fields are BadField; a dead invitation is NoInvite. Every refusal writes nothing and leaves the invitation live; a replay rebuilds the person, device and binding. The record round-trips, refuses truncation and trailing bytes, its Debug shows no subject, and split_external gives the plain Activated it contains. The bootstrap crate classifies the three new refusals as proven before any write.
